rules.waiting_time_policy: Waiting on review/compute converts to already-authorized preparation work; no empty actionable queue while unfinished work remains.

tasks.title: Construct exact untouched qualification packet
tasks.exact_action: Bind Function/Limit truth identities, generators, seeds, rates/durations, observation/reference transforms, channel applicability, inherited tolerance provenance, machine-readable multi-label adjudication, ordinary Function coverage, and FRAMEWORK_NOT_OPERATIONAL logic prospectively.
tasks.stop_condition: A nontrivial scientific choice cannot be resolved from the APQ-closed v0.3 architecture without outcome tuning.
tasks.note: Exact long-run packet was constructed, but some outcomes were opened before independent APQ. Existing packet/results are development-exposed only.

tasks.title: Construct exact matched-family execution packet
tasks.exact_action: Bind exact matrices/operators and matched families, physical state metric and input/output norms, finite horizons, perturbations, B/C mappings, time-varying law and stationary surrogate, seeds, rates/durations/noise, identity rules, target functionals, recoverability estimators, and machine-readable adjudication prospectively.
tasks.stop_condition: A nontrivial scientific choice cannot be resolved from the APQ-closed v0.3 architecture without outcome tuning.
tasks.note: Exact matched-family config was constructed, but execution authority is withheld pending independent APQ.

tasks.title: Packet-level APQ
tasks.deliverable: N-B1 packet APQ passes + ledger + revised packet if needed
tasks.exact_action: Obtain isolated independent APQ-2 adversarial review bound to the exact N-B1 v0.3 plan and long-run packet; adjudicate objections without majority voting; revise prospectively if needed.

tasks.title: Packet-level APQ
tasks.deliverable: N-B2/N-B3 packet APQ passes + ledger + revised packet if needed
tasks.exact_action: Obtain isolated independent APQ-2 adversarial review bound to the exact N-B2/N-B3 v0.3 plan and matched-family config; adjudicate objections without majority voting; revise prospectively if needed.

tasks.title: Prospective freeze and implementation
tasks.deliverable: Frozen N-B1 packet + machine-readable config + implementation + reproducibility section
tasks.exact_action: Freeze exact packet identity; implement without changing science; add contract tests and provenance.

tasks.title: Prospective freeze and implementation
tasks.deliverable: Frozen N-B2/N-B3 packet + machine-readable config + implementation + reproducibility section
tasks.exact_action: Freeze exact packet identity; implement matched-family generator/evaluator; add invariance and information-firewall contract tests.

tasks.title: Mechanical preflight and frozen execution
tasks.deliverable: Preflight then untouched qualification result artifact
tasks.exact_action: Run mechanical preflight only; if clean, execute the frozen untouched packet and preserve every row/failure/refusal.
tasks.stop_condition: Scientific deviation from frozen packet or unrepairable infrastructure block.

tasks.title: Mechanical preflight and frozen execution
tasks.deliverable: Preflight then frozen representation-sufficiency result artifact
tasks.exact_action: Run mechanical preflight only; if clean, execute the frozen matched-family packet and preserve every row/failure/refusal.
tasks.stop_condition: Scientific deviation from frozen packet or unrepairable infrastructure block.

tasks.title: Adjudicate Round-1 independent APQ
tasks.exact_action: Read all isolated reviews and adjudicate BLOCKER/MATERIAL objections without voting.

tasks.title: Revise architecture plans to v0.4
tasks.deliverable: N-B1 v0.4 and N-B2/N-B3 v0.4 plans
tasks.exact_action: Prospectively incorporate accepted Round-1 objections.

tasks.title: Build fresh v0.2 prefreeze draft
tasks.exact_action: Create outcome-blind fresh identities and explicit cross-lane/exposure firewalls without execution authority.

tasks.title: Establish lane-specific checkpoints
tasks.exact_action: Separate liveness/checkpoint/next-action state for both lanes.

tasks.title: Prebuild result-landing audit
tasks.exact_action: Freeze scientific review sequence before outcomes exist.

tasks.title: Validate v0.2 freshness and authority contracts
tasks.exact_action: Run freshness/identity/authority/no-result-reference checks.

tasks.title: Build full-text Round-2 APQ handoffs
tasks.exact_action: Provide reviewers full scientific authority text, not blob-only summaries.

tasks.title: Launch isolated Round-2 external APQ
tasks.exact_action: Retry after Undermind usage-limit reset; no duplicate search creation.
tasks.stop_condition: provider rate limit or completed reviews

tasks.title: Bind reusable prefreeze packet validator
tasks.exact_action: Validate semantic firewalls, Function/Limit coverage, target family separation, and no premature outcome exposure.

tasks.title: Update reproducibility guide for v0.2/APQ continuity
tasks.exact_action: Record exposure firewall, Round-1 adjudication, v0.4 plan identity, lane checkpoints, prefreeze CI, Round-2 transport state, and restart instructions.

tasks.title: Audit Function/Limit coverage before Round-2
tasks.exact_action: Check representative/adversarial balance and map each case to intended evidence channel/target without inspecting outcomes.

tasks.title: Exact v0.2 packet-level APQ and freeze
tasks.exact_action: After Round-2 architecture closure, review exact packet/config and freeze before substantive compute.
